page.layout: One page of text, with a full-width centred dedication title at the top. Below it, a woodcut initial in a box at the left, with the running text in the column to its right. Nothing in the margins, no running head. Foot: signature and page number centred.

main_text.head: INCLYTIS ET GENEROSIS COMITIBUS, D. IOHANNI, & D. NICOLAO, COMITIBUS AB OSTROROG, Virtute & Stemmatis Illustribus, S. D.
main_text.p: CUm in theatro urbis Attica olim recitarentur isti versus Aeschyli, de laudibus Amphiarai: Οὐ γὰρ δοκεῖν ἄρι-στος[?], ἀλλ' εἶναι θέλει, βαθεῖαν ἄλοκα διὰ φρενὸς καρπιμένος[?], ἀφ' ἧς τὰ κεδνὰ βλαστάει[?] βυλεύματα[?]: Spectatores quotquot aderant, oculos coniecerunt in Aristidem, cognomento Iustum: quem noverant nequaquam simulare amore studiumq; honesti, iusti & boni: sed ipsis factis declarare, totaq; vita testari.

page.notes: Woodcut initial "C" (historiated, figure with a staff in a landscape) at the left of the first paragraph; not transcribed. The Greek lines contain doubtful readings: "ἄρι-στος" is partly obscured at the line end, "καρπιμένος", "βλαστάει" and "βυλεύματα" are uncertain as printed and may be misprints or rendering errors. The Latin "testari" is read from a slightly blurred word. The last line of the page "mini" completes "Do-mini" from the previous line; it is text, not a catchword.
